d:
I had originally wanted to do all of the work and then release it in one go but I felt like if I didn't break this up in chapters, I would never push myself to get it done. Typesetting and redrawing is taking forever...

3/25/26: Updated chapter 2! Initially, I had given up on translating all of the grunts and moans but it bothered me to be inconsistent so I ended up going back and adding it back in. Maybe in my next translated work I'll do away with them, but then, how would you guys know they're cumming? I don't like giving out spoilers, but I do want to give out some content warning for the next coming chapters ahead: a bit of NTR and some Yaoi.

4/1/26: Updated chapter 3! Not much to say but I think publishing that first chapter really did kick in the motivation for me to finish this series. Look forward to chapters 4 and 5 sooner rather than later!

4/8/26: Surprise! I've updated both chapters 4 & 5 (along with the bonus pages), which completes the series. Hope you've enjoyed the wild ride!
